subtitle.en: Mid-year exams and what the results mean
subtitle.zu: Izivivinyo zaphakathi nonyaka nokuthi imiphumela isho ukuthini

blurb.en: Study help, three exams in four days, results and the holidays. About 6 minutes.
blurb.zu: Usizo lokufunda, izivivinyo ezintathu ezinsukwini ezine, imiphumela namaholide. Cishe imizuzu eyi-6.

text.en: Your first university exams. Everything you did this term counts now.
text.zu: Izivivinyo zakho zokuqala zasenyuvesi. Konke okwenzile kule temu kubalwa manje.

label.en: Lost study time to a power cut
label.zu: Ulahlekelwe yisikhathi sokufunda ngenxa yokucima kukagesi

label.en: Study skills from First Term coaching
Missed an exam with no sick note

title.en: Study help: what's worth paying for?

text.en: Exams are three weeks away. A tutor charges R250 an hour, seniors sell notes for R150, and someone offers to write your assignment for R300. The department runs free tutorials.
text.zu: Izivivinyo zisemasontweni amathathu. Umfundisi ubiza u-R250 ngehora, abafundi abadala bathengisa amanothi ngo-R150, futhi othile uthi angakubhalela umsebenzi ngo-R300. Umnyango unamathuthorial amahhala.

outcome.en: Two sessions help with one module. R500 is gone before exams start.
outcome.zu: Amaseshini amabili asiza ngesifundo esisodwa. U-R500 uhambile ngaphambi kokuqala kwezivivinyo.

outcome.en: The notes are two years old, and part of the syllabus has changed.
outcome.zu: Amanothi aneminyaka emibili, futhi ingxenye yesilabhasi isishintshile.

outcome.en: The work comes back copied from the internet. Handing it in could mean a misconduct hearing, so you redo it yourself.
outcome.zu: Umsebenzi ubuya ukopishwe ku-inthanethi. Ukuwuhambisa kungasho ukuqulwa kwecala lokungaziphathi kahle, ngakho uwenza kabusha wena.

tip.en: Handing in work someone else did is academic misconduct. It can cost you the module, or your place.
tip.zu: Ukuhambisa umsebenzi owenziwe ngomunye kuwukungaziphathi kahle kwezemfundo. Kungakulahlekisela isifundo, noma indawo yakho.

outcome.en: The department's tutorials are free, and past papers are on the library site. You go twice a week.
outcome.zu: Amathuthorial omnyango amahhala, futhi amaphepha adlule asesizeni somtapo. Uya kabili ngesonto.

tip.en: Check what's free before you pay: tutorials, past papers and consultation hours.
tip.zu: Hlola ukuthi yini emahhala ngaphambi kokukhokha: amathuthorial, amaphepha adlule namahora okubonisana.

text.en: The exam timetable is out: {mod1}, {mod2} and a third module, back to back.
text.zu: Uhlelo lwezivivinyo seluphumile: i-{mod1}, i-{mod2} nesinye isifundo, ngokulandelana.

outcome.en: You cover everything once, badly, and run on coffee.
outcome.zu: Udlula kukho konke kanye, kabi, futhi uphila ngekhofi.

outcome.en: Two-hour blocks, breaks and sleep. It's boring, and it works.
outcome.zu: Izikhathi zamahora amabili, amakhefu nokulala. Kuyadina, futhi kuyasebenza.

tip.en: Your exam timetable is on the student portal. Academic skills workshops hand out ready-made study planners.
tip.zu: Uhlelo lwakho lwezivivinyo lukuphothali yabafundi. Amasifundisane amakhono ezemfundo anikeza izinhlelo zokufunda esezilungisiwe.

outcome.en: You get the hours in. Your friends notice you've disappeared.
outcome.zu: Uthola amahora. Abangane bakho baqaphela ukuthi unyamalele.

text.en: The night before your first exam, your heart is racing and your mind goes blank when you look at your notes.
text.zu: Ubusuku obungaphambi kwesivivinyo sakho sokuqala, inhliziyo yakho igijima futhi ingqondo yakho iba yize uma ubheka amanothi akho.

outcome.en: You sit the exam on two hours of sleep. Your hands shake for the first ten minutes.
outcome.zu: Ubhala isivivinyo ulale amahora amabili. Izandla zakho ziyaqhaqhazela emizuzwini eyishumi yokuqala.

outcome.en: You close the books at ten, do a breathing exercise and sleep. Morning-you is grateful.
outcome.zu: Uvala izincwadi ngehora leshumi, wenze umsebenzi wokuphefumula bese ulala. Wena wasekuseni uyabonga.

outcome.en: A counsellor teaches you a grounding technique for the exam hall. You use it twice.
outcome.zu: Umeluleki ukufundisa indlela yokuzinzisa ehholo lesivivinyo. Uyisebenzisa kabili.

text.en: Your first university exams. Everything you did this term counts now.
text.zu: Izivivinyo zakho zokuqala zasenyuvesi. Konke okwenzile kule temu kubalwa manje.

text.en: Results are out. You passed some exams, but not {failed}. It's a shock, and it's also common in first year.
text.zu: Imiphumela isiphumile. Uphase ezinye izivivinyo, kodwa hhayi i-{failed}. Kuyashaqisa, futhi kuvamile onyakeni wokuqala.

outcome.en: You tell everyone it went fine. The weight of it follows you home.
outcome.zu: Utshela wonke umuntu ukuthi kuhambe kahle. Ubunzima balokho bukulandela ekhaya.

outcome.en: You check three things: what {failed} blocks next year, how many credits your funder needs, and when you can repeat it. It is bad news, but now it has edges.
outcome.zu: Uhlola izinto ezintathu: ukuthi i-{failed} ivimba ini ngonyaka ozayo, ukuthi umxhasi wakho udinga amakhredithi amangaki, nokuthi ungayiphinda nini. Yizindaba ezimbi, kodwa manje seziyaqondakala.

tip.en: A failed module can block the ones that follow it. Look up its prerequisites in the faculty handbook before you plan next semester.
tip.zu: Isifundo osehlulekile kuso singavimba ezilandelayo. Bheka ukuthi sidingwa yiziphi izifundo encwadini yefakhalthi ngaphambi kokuhlela isemesta elandelayo.

outcome.en: The advisor shows you what {failed} blocks, what it does to your funding, and the soonest you can repeat it. You leave with a plan for next semester.
outcome.zu: Umeluleki ukukhombisa ukuthi i-{failed} ivimba ini, yenzani oxhasweni lwakho, nokuthi ungayiphinda nini ngokushesha. Uhamba unohlelo lwesemesta elandelayo.

tip.en: Ask three questions: what does this block, what does it mean for my funding, and when can I repeat it?
tip.zu: Buza imibuzo emithathu: lokhu kuvimba ini, kusho ukuthini oxhasweni lwami, futhi ngingakuphinda nini?

title.en: A code instead of a mark

text.en: Results are in. Your key modules show marks, but next to {mod3} there is no mark, only a code: {suppCode}. Your stomach drops.
text.zu: Imiphumela isiphumile. Izifundo zakho ezibalulekile zinamamaki, kodwa eduze kwe-{mod3} awekho amamaki, kunekhodi kuphela: {suppCode}. Uyethuka.

outcome.en: You spend two days sure that you failed, and nearly miss the deadline to confirm. Code {suppCode} was never a fail.
outcome.zu: Uchitha izinsuku ezimbili uqiniseka ukuthi wehlulekile, futhi ucishe uphuthelwe usuku lokugcina lokuqinisekisa. Ikhodi {suppCode} yayingasho ukuthi wehlulekile.

outcome.en: Code {suppCode} means you are admitted to a supplementary exam: a second chance to write. You note the date and confirm that you will be there.
outcome.zu: Ikhodi {suppCode} isho ukuthi uvunyelwe ukubhala isivivinyo esengeziwe: ithuba lesibili lokubhala. Ubhala phansi usuku bese uqinisekisa ukuthi uzobe ukhona.

tip.en: A supp is a second opportunity, not a verdict on you. Plenty of graduates wrote one in first year.
tip.zu: Isivivinyo esengeziwe yithuba lesibili, akusona isahlulelo ngawe. Abaningi abathweswe iziqu babhala esisodwa onyakeni wokuqala.

outcome.en: At the perusal you see exactly where the marks went, and your lecturer points you to the past papers to practise. Now you know what to study.
outcome.zu: Ku-perusal ubona kahle ukuthi amamaki alahleke kuphi, futhi umfundisi wakho ukukhombisa amaphepha adlule okufanele uzilolonge ngawo. Manje uyazi ukuthi ufundeni.

tip.en: Study what you got wrong, not everything again. Past papers and a tutor beat rereading your notes.
tip.zu: Funda lokho okuphuthile, hhayi konke futhi. Amaphepha adlule nomfundisi osizayo kungcono kunokuphinda ufunde amanothi akho.

title.en: You passed the module you feared most

text.en: {mod1}: passed. You read the result three times to be sure.
text.zu: I-{mod1}: uphasile. Ufunda umphumela kathathu ukuze uqiniseke.

title.en: Your bursary is cut off mid-year

text.en: An email from your bursary: funding is suspended because your results or paperwork fell short. Your stipend stops this month, and you have ten days to appeal.
text.zu: I-imeyili evela kumxhaso wakho: uxhaso lumisiwe ngoba imiphumela noma amaphepha akho akwanelanga. Imali yakho iyama kule nyanga, futhi unezinsuku eziyishumi zokufaka isikhalazo.

outcome.en: You close the email and don't reply. The appeal deadline is still ten days away.
outcome.zu: Uvala i-imeyili futhi awuphenduli. Umnqamulajuqu wesikhalazo usesezinsukwini eziyishumi.

outcome.en: You send your results, a motivation and a study plan. The bursary agrees to review your case.
outcome.zu: Uthumela imiphumela yakho, incwadi yokuzichaza nohlelo lokufunda. Umxhaso uyavuma ukubuyekeza udaba lwakho.

tip.en: The appeal steps and deadline are in your bursary contract. Email your bursary officer, and keep copies of everything you send.
tip.zu: Izinyathelo zesikhalazo nomnqamulajuqu kusenkontilekeni yomxhaso wakho. Thumela i-imeyili esikhulwini somxhaso, futhi ugcine amakhophi akho konke okuthumelayo.

outcome.en: Financial aid helps you write the appeal and lists other funding you can apply for now.
outcome.zu: Abosizo lwezimali bakusiza ubhale isikhalazo futhi babala olunye uxhaso ongalufakela isicelo manje.

tip.en: Read your bursary contract for the pass requirements and the appeal process before you need them.
tip.zu: Funda inkontileka yomxhaso wakho ngezidingo zokuphasa nenqubo yesikhalazo ngaphambi kokuba uzidinge.

title.en: What your results mean for funding and progression
title.zu: Lokho imiphumela yakho ekushoyo kuxhaso nasekuqhubekeni

text.en: A notice explains that funders check how many credits you pass, and that some modules unlock second-year ones.
text.zu: Isaziso sichaza ukuthi abaxhasi bahlola ukuthi uphase amakhredithi amangaki, nokuthi ezinye izifundo zivula ezonyaka wesibili.

outcome.en: You archive the email. It'll still be true next semester.
outcome.zu: Ugcina i-imeyili. Kuzobe kusese yiqiniso ngesemesta elandelayo.

outcome.en: You work out how many credits you need this year, and write it on your wall.
outcome.zu: Ubala ukuthi udinga amakhredithi amangaki kulo nyaka, bese ukubhala odongeni lwakho.

outcome.en: Your module plan for next semester is checked against progression rules. No surprises later.
outcome.zu: Uhlelo lwakho lwezifundo lwesemesta elandelayo luhlolwa ngokwemithetho yokuqhubeka. Azikho izimanga kamuva.

title.en: Holidays: go home, or stay and work?
title.zu: Amaholide: uya ekhaya, noma uhlala usebenze?

text.en: Three weeks off. Home is calling, and a campus café is hiring for the holidays.
text.zu: Amasonto amathathu ekhefu. Ikhaya liyabiza, futhi ikhefi lasekhampasi liqasha ngamaholide.

outcome.en: Home food, your own bed, and everyone asking how varsity is. Travel and gifts cost R400.
outcome.zu: Ukudla kwasekhaya, umbhede wakho, futhi wonke umuntu ebuza ukuthi inyuvesi injani. Ukugibela nezipho kubiza u-R400.

outcome.en: You earn R1 200 and start next semester with a buffer. You miss home more than you expected.
outcome.zu: Uhola u-R1 200 futhi uqala isemesta elandelayo unemali eyisiphephelo. Ukhumbula ikhaya kakhulu kunalokho obukulindele.

tip.en: Holiday jobs are advertised by career services, the SRC and on campus notice boards. Apply before exams end.
tip.zu: Imisebenzi yamaholide ikhangiswa yizinsizakalo zemisebenzi, i-SRC nasemabhodini ezaziso ekhampasi. Faka isicelo ngaphambi kokuphela kwezivivinyo.

outcome.en: Two weeks working, one week home. A bit of both.
outcome.zu: Amasonto amabili usebenza, isonto elilodwa usekhaya. Kancane kokubili.

title.en: A power cut the night before an exam

text.en: The lights go out at 7pm and your phone is on 20%. Your exam is at 9am.
text.zu: Amalambu ayacima ngehora lesi-7 kusihlwa futhi ifoni yakho isele no-20%. Isivivinyo sakho singehora lesi-9 ekuseni.

outcome.en: The library has backup power. You find a seat on the third floor.
outcome.zu: Umtapo unogesi wokusekela. Uthola isihlalo esitezi sesithathu.

outcome.en: Your eyes ache by ten. You get through half your notes.
outcome.zu: Amehlo akho ayabuhlungu ngehora leshumi. Udlula engxenyeni yamanothi akho.

outcome.en: Your friend's area still has power. You quiz each other until midnight.
outcome.zu: Indawo yomngane wakho isenogesi. Nibuzana imibuzo kuze kube phakathi kwamabili.

title.en: A friend failed and wants to drop out

text.en: Your friend failed two exams and says they're going home for good. "I'm not made for this."
text.zu: Umngane wakho wehlulekile ezivivinyweni ezimbili futhi uthi ubuyela ekhaya unomphela. "Angenzelwanga lokhu."

outcome.en: They pack that weekend. Leaving can be right for some people, but they never found out their options.
outcome.zu: Bapakisha ngaleyo mpelasonto. Ukuhamba kungaba kuhle kwabanye abantu, kodwa abakaze bathole izindlela zabo.

outcome.en: Together you check what each failed module blocks, what it means for their funding, and when they can repeat. With an advisor's plan, they can still progress.
outcome.zu: Nindawonye nihlola ukuthi isifundo ngasinye abehluleke kuso sivimba ini, kusho ukuthini oxhasweni lwabo, nokuthi bangaphinda nini. Ngohlelo lomeluleki, basengaqhubeka.

tip.en: Failing a module is rarely the end. What matters is what it blocks, what the funder requires, and how soon it can be repeated.
tip.zu: Ukwehluleka esifundweni akuvamile ukuba yisiphetho. Okubalulekile ukuthi sivimba ini, umxhasi udingani, nokuthi singaphindwa ngokushesha kangakanani.

outcome.en: You sit with them while they book a counselling session. They stay, and they thank you months later.
outcome.zu: Uhlala nabo ngenkathi bebhukha iseshini yokwelulekwa. Bayahlala, futhi bayakubonga ezinyangeni ezilandelayo.

text.en: You wake up with a high fever on the morning of your {mod2} exam. You can barely stand, and the exam starts at 9.
text.zu: Uvuka unemfiva ephezulu ekuseni ngosuku lwesivivinyo sakho se-{mod2}. Awukwazi nokuma, futhi isivivinyo siqala ngo-9.

outcome.en: You get through two questions before the room starts spinning. Once you sit an exam, the mark usually stands.
outcome.zu: Uqeda imibuzo emibili ngaphambi kokuba igumbi lizungeze. Uma usuhlalele isivivinyo, amamaki avame ukuma.

label.en: Stay in bed, tell no one

outcome.en: You sleep through it. Without a medical certificate, a missed exam counts as absent.
outcome.zu: Ulala isivivinyo sidlule. Ngaphandle kwesitifiketi sikadokotela, isivivinyo esiphuthiwe sibalwa njengokungabikho.

label.en: See a doctor, request sick exam

outcome.en: Campus health gives you a medical certificate. You hand it in at your faculty office and get a date for a deferred exam.
outcome.zu: Umtholampilo wasekhampasi ukunika isitifiketi sikadokotela. Usiletha ehhovisi lefakhalthi yakho bese uthola usuku lwesivivinyo esihlehlisiwe.

tip.en: The certificate usually has to reach your faculty within a few days of the exam. Check your faculty's rule now, before you need it.
tip.zu: Isitifiketi ngokuvamile kufanele sifike efakhalthini yakho ezinsukwini ezimbalwa emva kwesivivinyo. Hlola umthetho wefakhalthi yakho manje, ngaphambi kokuba uwudinge.

text.en: Do you know how many modules you must pass this year to be allowed to continue?
text.zu: Uyazi ukuthi zingaki izifundo okufanele uziphase kulo nyaka ukuze uvunyelwe ukuqhubeka?

outcome.en: The faculty handbook gives the credits you must pass each year to avoid academic exclusion. Now you know where your line is.
outcome.zu: Incwadi yefakhalthi inikeza amakhredithi okufanele uwaphase unyaka ngamunye ukuze ugweme ukukhishwa. Manje uyazi ukuthi umugqa wakho ukuphi.

outcome.en: Fair enough. It is under "progression" or "exclusion rules" on the university website, or ask your faculty office.
outcome.zu: Kulungile. Kungaphansi kwe-"progression" noma "exclusion rules" kuwebhusayithi yenyuvesi, noma ubuze ehhovisi lefakhalthi yakho.
